text:
sam: quick reminder — we need the lockfile bump and vendor/submodule sync for release-2024.11 before cutoff today (5:00pm PT). please confirm owners so i can coordinate the merge window.

maya: i can take the infra-agent submodule. i have #4321 open, should be green after i rebase. planning to push by 3pm PT.

david: heads up, our acceptance CI is flaky on mac builders today, might delay vendor smoke. if anyone sees mac failures in the PRs ping me and i can rerun.

jessica: vendor build is failing on glibc mismatch when cross-compiling the grpc submodule. i opened a patch to pin the base image: #989. needs review from eng-ml.

ci-bot: [CI] external/vendor-build — failure on master (build 1182) 

sam: thanks. if the vendor CI is red we should still land submodule updates that are independent; we can gate the vendor bump behind a follow-up if needed. can owners post PR links here. i want a clear owner per path: e.g., infra-agent -> @maya, storage-vendor -> ?, ml-kernels -> ?.

maya: infra-agent -> PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra-agent/pull/4321. rebased and smoke passed locally. cc @sam

jessica: ml-kernels vendor change -> PR: https://git.redwood/internal/ml-kernels/pull/989. needs a quick +1 from @david for the build image change.

sam: if we need to manual-cut the lockfile, here's the flow i use:
```
# update submodule
git checkout release-2024.11
git pull origin main
cd submodules/infra-agent && git fetch && git checkout <sha> && cd -
# regenerate lockfile
make update-vendor-lock
git add vendor/ lockfile.yaml
git commit -m "chore: vendor lock bump before release-2024.11"
git push origin release-2024.11 && gh pr create --title "vendor: lock bump" --body "pre-release lock bump"
```

sam: if anyone can't get to their PR, ping me and i'll take ownership for landing (but only for safe, non-breaking bumps).

david: i'll review #989 in the next hour. could we also add a brief changelog note for the kernel pin? ops wants to see it.

jessica: yup i'll add a one-liner to CHANGELOG.md in that PR.

sam: plan: merge safe submodule bumps by 4:30pm PT, vendor lock bump by 5pm PT. if vendor CI is still failing at 4:50pm we do a soft rollback plan: revert vendor lock commit and ship without it, creating a follow-up hotfix. sound good? :thumbsup:

maya: sounds good, i'll notify infra for capacity bump at 3:45pm.

ci-bot: [DEPLOY] dry-run for release-2024.11 scheduled at 16:45 PT

sam: perfect — small reminder: add yourself as reviewer in the PR title with owner: prefix, e.g., "[owner:maya]" so release script picks it up.

david: reviewing now.

jessica: added changelog. re-running CI.

sam: thanks everyone — i'll do a final pass at 4:30 and start merge queue. reach out in here if anything blocks. :rocket:
